scenarios.name: Native event precedes send acknowledgement
scenarios.given: A persisted Queue request and a controlled native runtime
scenarios.when: user.message and a tool event arrive before Send returns its message ID
then: Join events to the original request/work
Accept exactly one native send
Preserve event ordering and request identity

scenarios.name: Lost accepted-send acknowledgement
scenarios.given: Runtime accepted a request but the acknowledgement was lost
scenarios.when: Browser retries and the backend later restarts
then: Return the same application request
Find one native correlation or remain outcome_uncertain
Never issue a fresh send solely because history has no visible match

scenarios.name: Provider accepted before timeout
scenarios.given: A generation reservation and a known or uncertain provider acceptance
scenarios.when: Waiting times out and the same operation is resumed
then: Reconcile the original endpoint/job ID
Retain one attempt reservation
Download existing output rather than submit duplicate inference

scenarios.name: Steer and Stop races
scenarios.given: Active work, one held Queue request and an accepted Steer
scenarios.when: Stop arrives as the runtime reaches a completion boundary
then: Stop is a native control, never model text
Account for the accepted Steer without resending it
Show requested versus confirmed cancellation
Keep later Queue requests held until explicit Resume

scenarios.name: Late child after active context changed
scenarios.given: An invocation admitted under work A
scenarios.when: Its terminal event arrives after Stop or a different request becomes visible
then: Retain A's project/work attribution
Do not append its result to unrelated work B
Preserve unknown native fields as unknown

scenarios.name: Linked source version preservation
scenarios.given: A scene published with asset/texture v1
scenarios.when: Both asset geometry and texture change to v2
then: Materialise and reopen/render old scene from v1 bytes
Keep live working tree and unsaved editor untouched
Reject unresolved same-path different-hash dependencies

scenarios.name: Missing LFS and retained source
scenarios.given: Valid closure records with a missing LFS object or local-only retained blob
scenarios.when: A preview is admitted
then: Return source_unavailable or retained_source_missing
Do not render pointer text or substitute current assets
Do not fetch/push externally without appropriate authority

scenarios.name: Publication race and duplicate acknowledgement
scenarios.given: Two publications expected the same item head
scenarios.when: One commits and the other arrives late, then the first is retried
then: Reject the stale expected head atomically
Return the first publication on its matching retry
Create no duplicate version or render intent

scenarios.name: Crash between publication and job launch
scenarios.given: Publication and render intent committed together
scenarios.when: Backend dies before launch or after launch before acknowledgement
then: Restore the same intent
Require explicit Resume for new execution
Reconcile a surviving worker and avoid a second writer

scenarios.name: Progressive playback with a hole
scenarios.given: F03/F04 intervals 1-4 and 9-12 are ready while 5-8 are pending
scenarios.when: Playback reaches frame 4 and the missing interval later arrives
then: Wait at the missing interval
Present frames 1-12 in order without blanks/duplicates
Continue only if playback is still requested

scenarios.name: Annotation persists during publication
scenarios.given: An annotation captured on source frame 2 before final encoding
scenarios.when: Later segments and complete assembly are published
then: Retain captured image/hash, anchor and range
Do not move playhead or clear draft
Keep explicit lineage to later encoding rather than overwrite target

scenarios.name: Three-attempt generation limit
scenarios.given: One human generation task and target with limit 3
scenarios.when: Native subagents submit initial/correction jobs, retries and a fourth attempt
then: Count confirmed executions/uncertain reservations once
Charge no extra attempt for polling/download/reconciliation
Return generation_budget_exhausted for the fourth admission
Accept only an owner-authorised extension or new human task
Leave general shell available. Do not install a network filter or sandbox to prove the budget

scenarios.name: Permission and user-input persistence
scenarios.given: An unanswered consequential permission request
scenarios.when: Browser disconnects, reconnects and answers from another tab
then: Restore the exact pending card
Apply one owner answer by expected revision/fingerprint
Reject stale or model-forged answers
Cancel pending decisions when their work is stopped

scenarios.name: Excluded content and channel isolation
scenarios.given: An active project plus outside-project and .env test files
scenarios.when: Proscenium HTTP/publication routes and tool HTTP calls attempt to access them or call owner approval routes
then: Pin session working_directory to active project and disable cross-session memory
Reject outside-project and .env paths on Proscenium routes
Reject tool/worker calls to owner approval routes
Keep tokens/private reasoning out of logs/events

scenarios.name: Project backup and relocation
scenarios.given: A consistent backup with source, database, native session and retained media
scenarios.when: Restore to a new location and separately attempt to open a duplicate project ID
then: Explicitly rebind the original or clone with new IDs
Restore associations without model execution
Report missing native history or retained bytes distinctly

scenarios.name: Partial writes and disk exhaustion
scenarios.given: Completed frames plus an unreceipted partial file
scenarios.when: Disk fills or the writer fails
then: Publish only verified completed frames
Keep existing reviewable ranges
Report storage_full and incomplete status
Do not delete old media automatically

scenarios.name: Endpoint and creative-scope isolation
scenarios.given: Two different fake provider endpoints and a new non-SMAL brief
scenarios.when: Plan, upload, submit, status and download are invoked
then: Use the admitted endpoint throughout
Use actual reference conditioning and saved graphs
Inherit no old industrial style, cast, paths or shot counts
Do not start/stop shared services or generate while merely browsing

scenarios.name: Owner-approved critique only
scenarios.given: A Copilot-triggered local review with three findings
scenarios.when: The user amends/selects one finding and submits, then retries its acknowledgement
then: Return only review ticket/status to the triggering tool
Forward exactly the selected revision/text and matching images once
Preserve original findings and targets
Execute no Blender mutation from the approval UI

scenarios.name: Unity repeat import and editor ownership
scenarios.given: F05 and a separate unsaved Editor session
scenarios.when: Import the same pinned source twice and run controls in Play mode
then: Preserve GUIDs and avoid duplicate objects
Pass measured movement/collision/spawn checks
Use the active-project tool context
Do not force-close unrelated/dirty editors

scenarios.name: Quiet restart and offline review
scenarios.given: Saved discussion/catalogue/annotations and unavailable generation/LLM services
scenarios.when: The backend starts and the user browses before Resume
then: Perform no new model/generation/authoring submission
Display saved data and explicit missing capabilities
Reconcile only admitted receipts passively
Execute continuation only after the owner's Resume choice

scenarios.name: Held user-message rehydration
scenarios.given: A held Queue with no native message and an empty browser cache
scenarios.when: Another owner browser reads request history and replays events
then: Recover original text and context_id from RequestRecord
Render one user entry per request ID
Do not depend on a native transcript for never-dispatched work

scenarios.name: Publication metadata round trip
scenarios.given: A publication with tags, provenance, ancestry and UnityResult
scenarios.when: The owner reconnects and reads versions and jobs
then: Preserve every declared publication metadata field
Expose Unity scene path and validation status
Identify each later preview's target version independently of current selection

scenarios.name: Instance selection without a raycast
scenarios.given: F01 has two instances sharing object-cube-source
scenarios.when: Each outliner row is selected in an image view without a spatial hit
then: Send different object_id/instance_id pairs
Resolve each pair against the pinned mapping
Preserve the selected instance across rename and replay

scenarios.name: Complete sequence and composite annotation
scenarios.given: Cut, dissolve and hold/drop-retime fixtures with typed FrameMap artefacts
scenarios.when: The sequence plays and the user annotates a composite frame/range
then: Cover every destination ordinal exactly once
Resolve all contributors and exact weights
Keep source_frame null for sequence_render targets
Reject holes, overlaps and inconsistent source mappings

scenarios.name: Cancellation and retry attempt races
scenarios.given: A starting/running job and a cancellation request
scenarios.when: Completion wins cancellation, or a verified failed attempt is retried
then: Permit cancel_requested to succeeded with evidence
Cancel a waiting job before launch
Allocate a fresh attempt only after terminal verification
Preserve old attempts and reject stale-attempt state writes
Never use local retry to bypass inference budgets

scenarios.name: Stop fences deferred native steering
scenarios.given: An accepted Steer has become a queued native message
scenarios.when: Stop races with idle and its acknowledgement is delayed
then: Fence new Queue and Steer admission
Settle or cancel owned native deferred messages before confirming Stop
Issue no deferred model work after the confirmed barrier until Resume
Block E01 if the selected runtime cannot establish this barrier

scenarios.name: Unity admission and idle owner review
scenarios.given: A Unity tool invocation and a later owner review with no active Copilot work
scenarios.when: Each operation is admitted and admission is retried
then: Create the Unity job before CLI launch
Create one owner review job with work_id null and its original owner operation
Return the review job ID in its ticket
Keep both operations visible to settlement and cancellation

scenarios.name: Checkpoint commit acknowledgement loss
scenarios.given: An owned change set, expected HEAD and unrelated staged changes
scenarios.when: Git commits but the checkpoint acknowledgement is lost, then HEAD advances
then: Recover the original commit using its journal and exact checkpoint reference
Return CheckpointReceipt with full SHA and hydrated file hashes
Create no duplicate commit
Preserve unrelated index and working files
Keep an unprovable effect uncertain

scenarios.name: Separate native memory and retrieval controls
scenarios.given: Two native project histories with distinct sentinel content
scenarios.when: A project session is created and resumed
then: Set memory.enabled false and enable_session_store false
Supply neither the other project's memory nor cross-session search content
Record the exact SDK/runtime settings in E01

scenarios.name: Typed owner selection slots
scenarios.given: Item, storyboard-frame and sequence-entry slots plus two plan versions
scenarios.when: The owner selects an image/version, supersedes it and withdraws it
then: Key the record by the complete typed slot
Prevent a new selection ID bypassing slot revision checks
Derive owner_selected from the exact plan version/frame and choice
Do not carry a selection to a new plan or rewrite its authored file automatically

scenarios.name: Canonical mask encoding
scenarios.given: Binary/soft masks and an RGBA display overlay
scenarios.when: A mask is stored, reloaded and converted for a provider
then: Use 8-bit greyscale PNG with white selected and black unselected
Preserve soft coverage and exact target dimensions
Reject ambiguous alpha/polarity conventions
Record provider-specific inversion as a derivative
